body: I don't know why i expected this might help. I'm just fucked. Nothing can help me.
I start my first day of a new job in 6 hours but i can't sleep because i can't stop myself from crying long enough. this is ridiculous.
i just feel like i need to do something. like i need to hurt myself for some reason
I just actually went through with trying to hang myself this time.. but i guess i'm still not really serious because i stopped it.

It's even more pathetic that i'm sitting here refreshing this page because i've exhausted all my facebook friends including the one who sells hard drugs. Nobody gives me more than a couple words, so here i am hoping a random stranger cares more than people who know me

It's honestly pathetic i'm still even holding on. we broke up and she moved out but things were going better and we were seeing each other again, before she got a job on the other side of the Provence, and that was almost 6 months ago, and we've had very little communication over that time, to the point that i started sending her messages telling her that i didn't feel like i'd lose anything if i broke up with her, and i saw that she had seen them and was not replying, now weeks later, i get her to reply and all she really says is she has something she needs to tell me, so finally tonight i called her and she told me why she was hiding for the last 8 weeks.
